verdict.rationale: Settlement reconciliation is a fair question for a payment gateway/aggregator like Kushki, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of settlement reports, bank-deposit matching, or itemized fee and chargeback reporting. The refunds doc (kushki-docs-8) covers processing voids and refunds, not reconciliation reporting. The payouts page (kushki-docs-18) covers paying suppliers and employees, not settlement reconciliation. Neither earns credit.
